s1_prime_f1.cross_arm_honest_framing: The exact dense center solve removed the in-band truncation (w-sweep residuals decay monotonically within the clamp; the rank-limited plateau class of iteration-3 is gone [INVALIDATED-HISTORY motivation only]) BUT the far-tail coupling of the whole-sample-symmetric DST2 embedding of the FREE operator is FULL-SUPPORT-sized, not band-sized: s = 4096 (all cells) at 64x64 and ~99.5% of cells at 128x128, w_s 31/63 vs clamps 8/16, coverage 4.33/6.84 -- the boundary effect is NOT containable by a w-clamp, so the F1 regime w <= min(H,W)/8 cannot contain the exactness problem by construction (fork A). The full-support exact solve is O(nb^3) with nb_tail 12033/48641 -- dense-cost-infeasible under the ~2 GB cgroup (center alone ~1.16/18.93 GB). The DST2 comparator (58.46% pooled median reduction) remains ahead of F1 (46.66%); capture ratio 0.7531 (75.3%) HOLDS under the iter-3 ratio convention. The verdict is NOT-validated-guard by the pinned precedence, with all clauses (w_s/s/coverage, gap 46.66% < 50%, residual 516.3 >> 1e-6, capture 0.7531) reported per grid and pooled so the attribution stays interpretable.

strategy_implications.headline: Iteration-4 is a MEASURED NEGATIVE for both pre-registered strategy families: F1 NOT-validated-guard, F2 REFUTED, benchmark REFUTED. The declared F3 fallback (negative-result + tooling repositioning, proposal-iter4-v4 fallback_strategy) is now the honest default deliverable of the cycle.
strategy_implications.measured_structure_of_the_f1_close: The exact dense center solve removed in-band truncation, but the mirror/reflection coupling of the whole-sample-symmetric DST2 embedding of the FREE operator has FULL-SUPPORT extent: support set S covers all 64x64 cells (s = 4096) and ~99.5% of 128x128 cells (median s = 16308.5); support distance w_s 31/63 vs clamps 8/16; coverage s/|T_w| 4.33/6.84. No w-band of size min(H,W)/8 can contain it (fork A), and the exact full-support center is O(nb^3) at nb_tail 12033/48641 -- dense-cost-infeasible under the ~2 GB cgroup (center estimates ~1.16 GB / ~18.93 GB). The 32x32 full-tail exactness references (matern32 res 9.19e-05; rbf res 1.65e-12) prove the exact formulation itself is correct -- the blocker at claim scale is COST, not model error. Within this embedding class, the F1 w-clamp hypothesis is CLOSED by fork A; the honest boundary-class positive residue is the DST2 comparator itself (58.46% pooled median reduction).

ranked_directions.direction: Boundary-model change -- explicit boundary-value / finite-domain formulations instead of embedding the free operator and correcting the full-support mirror coupling: Dirichlet-zero / Neumann-zero boundary conditioning is already tooled in scripts/grf_boundary.py (G8), and the correct spectral object would be the symmetric-boundary operator itself (Strang 74: DCT/DST as eigenbasis of symmetric-boundary operators), not a corrected embedding of the free operator.
